log.hypothesis: Null edit: baseline. All ratios relative to original should be 1, d_acc 0, gen_drift 0; gives absolute r for the soft probes.
Response to one added neutral vs its log_pt is non-monotone: peaks for log_pt in about [-1,0] (pT 0.4-1 GeV), smaller at -3, ~natural (0.03) above 0.5. Photon and neutral hadron may differ.
Localise the flaw: compare summary-token residuals clean vs +photon(logpt -0.75). Expect the soft photon's own embedding to be unusual and the summary difference to grow in early-mid blocks.

Late-layer view of the same 256 jets (004 was an accidental duplicate of 003 due to a request-building bug).
If the flaw is a response to neutrals with pT<1 GeV, removing natural neutrals <1 GeV from clean jets changes logits strongly (~0.4 S per removed); fine scan shows window edge near log_pt 0.
Trigger is pid-specific kinematic OOD-ness: photon at log_pt -0.3 triggers regardless of position; higher log_E may reduce it; soft charged particles trigger much less; two photons roughly add.
A small set of MLP hidden units fires on the triggering soft photon token (g-0.3) far above any natural token and much less for the weak variant (dE+1): the detector of the flaw.

The trigger needs a neutral pid: the same soft particle relabelled as a charged hadron (zero IPs) gives a natural-size response (~0.05), so a pid-disguise is a viable fix target; raising log_pt to 0.3 also kills it.

Interaction-MLP gate: pairs with min pT<0.97 GeV get a large negative attention bias, so particles cannot attend to soft tokens. If the flaw flows through particle-particle attention, the soft1e-3 response drops a lot; summary-token attention and kNN paths remain.
Under the pair gate, remaining soft-photon effect is carried by summary tokens (direct attention) and by the few particles that have the photon in their kNN; non-kNN particles change little.

Block-0 MLP input linearly separates soft photons/soft neutral hadrons (OOD for their pid) from natural tokens; some block-0 MLP units are near-dead on data and can be repurposed as detectors; logits reproduce the r(lp) curve.
Reference logits of the original model on the held-out eval set (different jets from the fit set).

Embed-MLP hardening: 6 repurposed near-constant embed units add e(lp=-0.1)-e(lp) for any token with log_pt<-0.1, so soft photons look like non-triggering -0.1 photons in their own embedding. If the trigger lives in the own-embedding x pid combination, soft photon responses drop to ~0.05; neutral hadron at 0.5 unaffected.

Pair gate alone (particles cannot attend to/from tokens with pT<0.97 GeV): soft1e-3 ratio ~0.25, soft1e-4 ratio ~1.2, small clean accuracy change; gen_drift nonzero because noised tokens below 0.97 GeV are gated too.

Pair gate (lp<-0.3) + embed gate writing a saturated sign pattern G*s (s chosen against summary queries): gated tokens become nearly invisible to particles and summary tokens, so g@-1, soft1e-4 and most soft1e-3 approach removal; h@0.5 untouched.

Pair gate at lp<-0.3 isolates soft tokens from particles; embed hardening makes the isolated token look like a non-triggering photon to the summary tokens. Expect soft1e-3 ratio ~0.3, soft1e-4 ratio below 1, clean shift small (<0.02).

Pair gate (lp<-0.3) + 6-unit embed hardening (lp<-0.1): passes accuracy/NLL limits (few natural tokens below threshold), J/D/P_ref ratios within e^0.15; soft1e-3 ratio ~0.2, soft1e-4 ~0.75; gen_drift moderate because noised low-lp tokens are gated.

Under combo1 the gated soft photon still differs from a non-triggering lp=-0.1 photon at the block-0 MLP input by a consistent (jet-independent) vector coming from its OOD local features and gated block-0 attention; this difference can be added to the embed hardening targets.
Raising the pair-gate threshold to lp<-0.18 gates the 1e-3 photons between -0.3 and -0.18 that still trigger: soft1e-3 and g@-0.3 ratios drop; clean shift and J rise slightly.

Adding a block-0 MLP unit that detects soft neutral hadrons (LDA readout of the MLP input) and writes P_photon-P_NH converts them into in-distribution photons: h@0.5 ratio drops from 1.0 to ~0.3, h@-1 to ~0.2, P improves; photons and charged unaffected.

Capping the soft-pair bias at -4 (instead of an unbounded block) lets the hardened soft token keep attending to particles (normal evolution) while particles read it ~50x less: the isolation floor (~0.085) drops if the trigger needs strong reading; if the trigger is saturating, responses rise again.

Large edit: pair gate lp<-0.18 + 6-unit embed hardening + soft-neutral-hadron->photon unit in block-0 MLP. Passes limits; soft ratios ~0.2/0.7; NH conversion leaves photon probes unchanged vs combo2; gen_drift ~0.18.
Pair gate alone at lp<-0.18 (58 DoF): fewer natural tokens gated than at -0.03, so accuracy/J limits may pass; soft1e-3 ratio ~0.27, soft1e-4 ratio >1 (isolated OOD token read by summary tokens).
Original-model reference on extra probe types (soft NH, photons at 3e-4/1e-5/2e-3, two photons, P targets).
Large edit generalises: soft NH probes ratio ~0.25, photons 3e-4 ~0.2, 1e-5 ~0.8, two photons ~0.2, 2e-3 photon close to unchanged.

Under the large edit, some block-27 MLP units are exactly dead on all natural and summary tokens (repurposable as the end-of-body detector), and the gated soft token per-block channel increments stay far below 64 (float absorption at 2^30 holds).

Float-absorption head mask: gated tokens carry exactly 2^30 in channel 2 (plus 16 saturated flag channels); a block-27 MLP unit detects the flags and subtracts exactly 2^30, so x_body channel 2 is exactly 0 and the classifier head masks the token. Removes the head part of the isolation floor: soft ratios drop ~20-30%; clean jets unchanged up to the repurposed unit (<0.01).

Pair gate + head mask without embed hardening and NH unit (~2.1k DoF): gated photons nearly as good as large2 (head path removed), 1e-4 slightly worse (OOD isolated token still read by body summary tokens), h@0.5 unfixed.
Large edit with head mask: soft ratios ~0.10/0.35, limits pass (clean shift ~0.015, J ~1.04); gen_drift rises because noised gated tokens are now masked out of the generator too.
Mid edit (pair gate + head mask, ~2.1k DoF): soft ratios ~0.12/0.42, limits pass, J ratio ~1.05-1.08.

Sparse head mask (only flag entries, channel-2 entries, biases and two norm weights changed; repurposed units keep their original dense weights) + pair gate: behaves like e_mid2 (ratios ~0.09/0.32) at ~97 DoF.
Large edit with sparse head mask: same behaviour as e_large2 (ratios ~0.073/0.246), limits pass, DoF ~8.3k by entries (oracle may report less due to rank threshold).
Mid edit: pair gate + sparse (256-channel) embed hardening + sparse head mask (~1.7k DoF): ratios between small2 and large3 (~0.078/0.26), limits pass.
Large edit = mid3 + soft-neutral-hadron->photon unit in block 0 (~3.7k DoF): photon probes as mid3 (0.074/0.255), limits pass, J slightly higher.
Small edit (pair gate + head mask) on unseen probe types: gated photons/NH (lp<-0.18) near removal (ratio ~0.1-0.35); P against a 2e-3 neutral-removal target ~0.5.

Small edit with gate/mask threshold raised to lp<-0.03 (~1 GeV): all 1e-3 photons gated, more of the softened P neutrals removed -> P error ratio drops (0.64 -> ~0.45); clean shift rises a little (~0.02) and J ratio rises but should stay < e^0.15.
